violations.why: req4_isr can preempt main between the two reads of test_global_var1 in JudgeCondi, so they can see different values.
req3_isr can write test_global_var2 between main's two reads.
req2_isr can preempt req1_isr between its two writes and read the intermediate value 0x33.
Another ISR (req4) can preempt req3 and overwrite irq between its write and the check, so the check can fail.
req3_isr or another ISR can overwrite irq between req4's write and its check.
req2_isr can change irq between req1's write and the read in pca_isa_probe.
Another ISR's init or exit can overwrite global_id between this ISR's init and the compare in probe.
Another ISR can overwrite global_dev between init and the compare in probe.
